# IV30 Retail Lag Event Study — AAPL

## Hypothesis
After strong upside spot momentum (top decile 5d return), 
retail call buying in subsequent days lifts IV30 and call 
skew with a lag of ~3-7 days. Goal: position in monthly 
options before retail arrives in weeklies.

## Method
Event study, not regression. For each signal date, track 
ATM IV30, 25d call IV, and 25d risk reversal paths over 
horizons 0-15 days. Compare to random-date control sample. 
Bootstrap peak excess for significance.

## Key design choices
- Monthlies preferred over weeklies (better spreads, 
  cleaner vega capture, lower hedging cost for MMs)
- Exclude ±10 days around earnings
- Post-2021 sample (retail flow regime change)
- Control for trailing 20d realized vol
